summary: Single unified Firebase-based app with role-based access (user/admin/super_admin), global header + profile popup, and an in-app admin dashboard for user management and other sections.
architectural_notes: Use Firebase Authentication for user signup/login.
Persist user profiles in Firestore at users/{uid} with role-based authorization (user/admin/super_admin) and approval status.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Flat chat-bubble logo icon with a simple green palette on transparent background (app-logo.dim_256x256.png)

existing_features.title: Align the Firestore user document schema to exactly `users/{uid}` with fields: `name` (string), `email` (string), `photoURL` (string), `role` ("user" | "admin" | "super_admin"), `approved` (boolean), and `createdAt` (Firestore timestamp). Ensure signup writes these fields and that subsequent profile reads in the app use these fields.

Implement the first-ever signup rule: when the users collection has no users, the first created account must be assigned `role = "super_admin"` and `approved = true`; all subsequent signups must be assigned `role = "user"` and `approved = false`.

Add a global header that is displayed on all pages in the single app. Header layout: left side shows app logo + app name; right side shows the current user’s profile picture (clickable) when authenticated.

Implement the profile popup opened by clicking the header avatar. The popup must always show the user’s name and role. If the role is `admin` or `super_admin`, also show an "Open Admin Dashboard" button. Always show a "Logout" button that signs the user out and returns them to the login screen.

Add an in-app Admin Dashboard area within the same application (no separate admin app). Access must be restricted to users whose Firestore role is `admin` or `super_admin`. Include the following pages/sections: Dashboard (stats), Users list, Chats, Reports, Settings.

Implement the Users list page in the Admin Dashboard that lists all user documents from `users` (including `super_admin` users) and supports user management actions with role-based permissions: Admins can approve users, block users, and change role between `user` and `admin`. Super admins can do all admin actions and can promote users to admin. Enforce that "super_admin is also a normal user with extra permissions" and appears in the user list.

Update Firestore security rules to enforce the role-based permissions required by the admin dashboard and user management, while keeping regular users limited to reading/updating only their own profile (excluding role/approved changes). Ensure admins can read all users for listing. Ensure rules restrict any attempt to set `role` to `super_admin` via client writes and restrict modifications to existing `super_admin` users’ roles/approval by non-super_admins.

Apply a clean, WhatsApp-style, mobile-friendly UI across the unified app (auth screens, header, home, and admin dashboard) with consistent spacing, typography, and a green-forward palette (avoid blue/purple). Keep all user-facing text in English.
Add a static app logo image asset and render it in the global header next to the app name.

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement Firebase Auth signup/login; on first-ever signup auto-assign role=super_admin and approved=true
Create Firestore users/{uid} documents with fields name, email, photoURL, role, approved, createdAt; ensure every user including super_admin appears in user list
Add global header on all pages with app logo/name (left) and clickable user profile picture (right)
Profile popup from avatar showing name+role; show 'Open Admin Dashboard' for admin/super_admin; always include Logout
Role-based route/access control: Admin Dashboard accessible only to admin or super_admin; single unified app (no separate admin app)
Admin Dashboard pages: Dashboard (stats), Users list, Chats, Reports, Settings
User management: Admin can approve/block users and change role user↔admin; Super admin can do all admin actions and promote users to admin
UI: clean, WhatsApp-style simple and mobile-friendly across the unified app

projectName: Unified Firebase app with role-based access, global header/profile menu, and in-app admin dashboard
